jobs.title: Customer Sales Associate, Ayala Cebu
jobs.description: We are looking for a Customer Sales Associate to provide attentive, knowledgeable, and personalized customer service. This is position will be reporting to work at Ayala Cebu . You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Customer Engagement and Service Delivery Welcome and acknowledge customers in a warm, respectful, and professional manner. Observe customer behaviour and offer assistance at an appropriate time without creating unnecessary pressure Understand customer needs through relevant questions and active listening. Assist customers in identifying suitable products based on preferences, occasion, size, and availability. Maintain a helpful and respectful approach throughout the customer journey. Handle routine customer inquiries and refer concerns requiring authorization to the Store Head. Product Knowledge and Merchandise Assistance Maintain working knowledge of current collections, product categories, sizes, styles, features, and available merchandise. Explain product information accurately and avoid unsupported claims. Recommend appropriate complementary products when relevant to customer needs. Assist with product selection, fitting-room requirements, alternative sizes, and styling options. Maintain appropriate customer privacy, comfort, and professional boundaries. Sales Productivity Contribute to the achievements of store sales targets through effective customer assistance. Apply customer engagement techniques that support conversion, ATV, UPT, and other approved KPIs. Participate in daily sales briefings and understand assigned productivity objectives. Respond constructively to coaching and implement agreed improvements. Balance sales productivity with the brand’s non-hard-selling service philosophy. Selling-Floor and Merchandise Standards Maintain cleanliness, orderliness, and presentation of assigned selling areas. Replenish merchandise and maintain correct product placements, size arrangement, and display standards. Ensure

Validate system transactions and ensure data accuracy. Process approved data corrections and modifications. Conduct system testing and simulations for updates and new system implementations.

jobs.title: Office and Sales Manager
jobs.description: Job Description — Office and Sales Manager The Office and Sales Manager oversees daily office operations and coordinates the company’s sales activities. The role supports efficient administrative processes, helps the sales team meet its targets, and maintains strong relationships with clients. Key responsibilities Manage daily office operations, including records, supplies, equipment, and administrative procedures. Coordinate sales activities, monitor leads and opportunities, and track progress against sales targets. Support the preparation of quotations, proposals, sales reports, and presentations. Respond to client inquiries and help maintain positive customer relationships. Coordinate with internal teams to support timely delivery of products or services. Prepare regular reports on sales performance, customer feedback, and office operations. Guide and support office and sales staff, assign tasks, and monitor follow-through. Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and sales performance. Ensure office and sales activities follow company policies and procedures.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description: Your Impact Areas 1. Achieve Sales Revenue Targets Lead the team to meet or exceed overall sales goals. Track sales performance and implement actions to close gaps. 2. Improve Opportunity-to-Win Conversion Rates Guide the team in effective prospecting, qualification, and deal closing. Monitor pipeline health and address obstacles impacting conversion. 3. Manage Individual and Team Quota Attainment Set clear quotas and review performance regularly. Provide coaching and support to ensure consistent achievement. 4. Develop and Execute Strategic Sales Plans Create and refine strategies based on data, customer insights, and market trends. Align team initiatives with core KPIs and organizational priorities. 5. Strengthen Customer Relationships Maintain high customer satisfaction and identify growth opportunities. Support the team in upselling, cross-selling, and retention efforts. 6. Coach and Develop the Sales Team Deliver ongoing training, mentoring, and performance feedback. Build a high-performance culture focused on continuous improvement. 7. Analyze Sales Data for Decision-Making Track KPIs such as revenue achievement, conversion rates, and quotas. Report insights that guide strategic and operational adjustments. 8. Collaborate Across Departments Work with marketing, operations, and other teams to support sales initiatives. Share market and customer feedback for product and service enhancement.
